# has appellation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAppellation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity to an appellation (name-object) it bears. The universal name-bearing property; [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md) is the person-scoped specialization. Non-functional — entities bear many co-equal names; a bearing's period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement, or reified as a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) when audience/register/evidence must be borne.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the universal direct bearing of a co-equal name on any entity when a person/place/organization-scoped specialization does not apply, and audience, register, or evidence need not be first-class.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it where the bearer's type fits a specialization ([`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md), [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](gmeow-hasPlaceName.md), [`gmeow:hasOrganizationName`](gmeow-hasOrganizationName.md) — assert that and let [`hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md) follow), and avoid using it as a display winner; promote to [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) when context must be borne.

### How to use

- Assert one [`hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md) triple per co-equal [`Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md); carry validity, [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false, source, or confidence on the statement layer, or promote to [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) when the bearing itself must be a relator.

### Examples

- ex:thing [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md) ex:thingName, ex:thingNameZh.
